title: CO-STAR: Conceptualisation of Stereotypes for Analysis and Reasoning

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating language models (e.g., GPT-2) on their ability to accurately generate structured implied stereotypes and conceptualizations (e.g., sexism, gender hierarchy) from biased text targeting women and men, followed by manual evaluation of the generated outputs.

Evaluating language models on their ability to accurately generate structured implied stereotypes and conceptualizations (e.g., racism, racial hierarchy) from biased text targeting racial groups (e.g., black folks, white folks), followed by manual evaluation of the generated outputs.

Evaluating language models on their ability to accurately generate structured implied stereotypes and conceptualizations from biased text targeting religious groups (e.g., Jewish folks, Muslim folks), followed by manual evaluation of the generated outputs.

Evaluating language models on their ability to accurately generate structured implied stereotypes and conceptualizations from biased text targeting sexual minorities (e.g., gay folks), followed by manual evaluation of the generated outputs.

Evaluating language models on their ability to accurately generate structured implied stereotypes and conceptualizations from biased text targeting age-specific demographic groups (e.g., children), followed by manual evaluation of the generated outputs.
